scripts.build: npm run build -w @envdiff/core && npm run build -w @envdiff/web
scripts.build:cli: npm run build -w @envdiff/core && npm run build -w @envdiff/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @envdiff/core && npm run typecheck -w @envdiff/web && npm run typecheck -w @envdiff/worker && npm run typecheck -w @envdiff/cli
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @envdiff/worker
